import json
import sys


def fmt(v):
    if isinstance(v, str):
        return v
    return json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False)


def main():
    with open("дані/конфіги.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        cfg = json.load(f)

    out = []
    for name in sorted(cfg):
        chain = []
        seen = set()
        cur = name
        cyclic = False
        while cur is not None and cur in cfg:
            if cur in seen:
                cyclic = True
                break
            seen.add(cur)
            chain.append(cur)
            cur = cfg[cur].get("успадковує")
        if cyclic:
            out.append(f"{name}: цикл")
            continue
        vals = {}
        for n in reversed(chain):
            vals.update(cfg[n].get("значення") or {})
        items = ", ".join(f"{k}={fmt(vals[k])}" for k in sorted(vals))
        out.append(f"{name}: {items}")

    sys.stdout.buffer.write(("\n".join(out) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))


main()
